content.short: Tonstakers is the largest liquid staking protocol on TON, allowing users to earn rewards while keeping assets liquid.
content.description: Tonstakers is the leading liquid staking protocol in the TON ecosystem, offering a secure and efficient way for users to participate in network validation. By staking Toncoin through Tonstakers, users receive tsTON, a liquid token that represents their staked position and automatically accrues rewards. This allows users to remain liquid and use their tsTON in other DeFi protocols while still earning staking rewards, providing the perfect balance between network security and financial flexibility.
content.meta: Maximize your TON rewards with Tonstakers, the leading liquid staking protocol. Explore on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
